heading.text: AI learning tools for global teams, as capable as the apps you open every day

content.paragraph: Thanks to Nova, it's never been easier to run learning at a global scale. Coach teams in Lisbon while you check what's working in Sydney, all with one prompt. Handle admin 25x faster and create brilliant learning with Nova.

tabs.text: Nova spots the compliance gap in one region before your board even asks about it, surfacing engagement and performance dips the moment they happen, not weeks later.
Brief Nova once and get a course, quiz or video ready for review in minutes, shaped for the team, country and language it is landing in.
Nova coaches one team on negotiation and another on compliance at the same time, each in their own language, with no human trainer needed in the room.
Nova finds and archives stale content across every region 25x faster than manual tidying, turning a four-hour job into a two-minute one, so your platform team gets their week back.
Ask Nova one question and get the answer pulled from every connected system and every course file you own, with no more searching five places for one answer.

content.heading: The new standard for enterprise learning management platforms

paragraph.text: Search every connected system in one query, unlock years of course content sitting unused in your archives, and run Nimbus from the assistants your teams already use.

tabs.title: One search for every answer.
tabs.text: Whether it lives in your documents, chat tools, wikis, shared drives, intranet or course library, Nimbus finds the right answer for every single person and shows them exactly where it came from, in seconds.

tabs.title: Search inside every course you own.
tabs.text: Nimbus reads the content inside uploaded course packages, so learners can jump straight to the lesson, slide or video moment that answers their question.

tabs.title: Run Nimbus from the AI tools you already use every day.
tabs.text: Create spaces, assign courses and pull reports from your favourite AI assistant, with the same permissions and audit trail as the platform itself, every time.

tabs.title: Build the learning tools you imagine.
tabs.text: Describe a quiz, a checklist or a mini app in plain words and Nimbus builds it for you in moments, ready to share with any team, site or region in a single click.
